question: What spiritual attainment results from reading or teaching this tantra?
premises: A person may read this tantra.
A person may also cause others to read it.
Such engagement leads to becoming a knower of Brahman.
inference: By reading or teaching this tantra, a person may become a knower of Brahman.
plain_english: A person who has read or taught this tantra may become a knower of Brahman.
